headline: Bitcoin Reclaims $60,000 Following Broader Risk Asset Recovery
summary: Bitcoin climbed back above the $60,000 psychological threshold after gaining more than 3% in 24 hours, though weekly losses remained near 5% amid broader risk asset recoveries.
why: Bitcoin is the largest digital asset by market capitalization, often acting as a high-beta indicator for broader risk sentiment in financial markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Inflows into risk assets directly drive up cryptocurrency spot prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A recovery in technology stocks and broader risk-on sentiment in Asian and global sessions sparked renewed buying in digital assets.
